page.overview:
Who is Alexander Luthor?

At some point in time, Lex Luthor became acknowledged on his reality. When the Crisis erupted, an alternate Lex came to this reality and killed its Superman. As the TV showed the news, Lex Luthor was blamed for his death and believed to have vanished in thin air.

Later that day, Lex died after his reality was destroyed by an anti-matter wave sent by the Anti-Monitor. After the Paragons rebooted the Multiverse, Lex Luthor was brought back to life after Earth-75 was restored to the existence.
